ValidationRule.description: Stage changes on non-Renewal deals need a Next Step. Exempt since 2026-09-24 (Aaron): the CUSTOM - SF Admin profile and any profile or role containing Marketing.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(OR( $Profile.Name = "CUSTOM - SF Admin", CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Marketing"), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, "Marketing") )), RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Renewal", ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")), ISBLANK(NextStep) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Update Next Step before changing stages.
